summary: Learn to connect cyber, technology, third-party and AI risk through office structures, KRIs and board reporting. Explore the course.
lede: Digital risk and resilience office training helps risk, security and technology leaders coordinate cyber, technology, operational, third-party and AI oversight. Participants practise setting an office charter and shared risk taxonomy, mapping controls and dependencies, and developing key risk indicators and board reporting with escalation tied to risk appetite.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate, assess, challenge or report digital risk across business and technology functions. It suits experienced risk and control practitioners who want to connect existing cyber, technology and operational processes through a practical office model.
modules: COSO ERM Risk Appetite and KRIs
NIST AI RMF and ISO 22301 Playbooks
COSO ERM Board Pack and Roadmap
prerequisites: Working familiarity with at least one of enterprise risk, operational risk, cybersecurity or technology risk is recommended. No coding or programming is required; advanced AI-risk topics receive conceptual and operational oversight coverage rather than technical implementation.
